title: Frozen Trail is live! Play for free October 8-12
body:
# Frozen Trail has arrived! Free to play October 8-12

Raiders,

The Frozen Trail update is now live. Update your game and take your first frosted steps onto Pendola Pass.

Full details on the update are available in the Patch Notes.

# Beyond the Rust Belt

The Ballistic Gondolas are operational, and Shani has cleared Raiders to use them. The time has come to climb the mountain and begin exploring Pendola Pass.

You're among the first wave of Raiders venturing past the Rust Belt into this new region. Solid information about what's on the other side of the mountain ridge remains scarce. What is known: one of the Emperors has fallen, and ARC is mobilizing in response.

# The ARC response

Valuable technology is hidden inside the wrecked Emperor, much like inside the Frigate, which has now shown up to patrol the Rust Belt. Step into ARC's mechanical domain and hunt for rewards that Speranza has never seen before.

Fresh dangers are waiting in Pendola Pass. The Bully will pin you down and bombard your position without mercy. The Skulker tries to get the better of you, lurking in the shadows and ambushing you when you're not looking. The Hydra handles multiple threats at once, wiping out squads as it defends both the Emperor and the Frigate.

# Gear up before you go

Raiders shouldn't head into this new territory unequipped. Build up your Outpost to push your weapons to tier five and unlock their special abilities. Take advantage of new skills, keep your supplies stocked with gear such as Tethers and the Grapple Hook, and expand your loadout with two brand-new weapons.

# Free to play: October 8-12

Remember, ARC Raiders is free-to-play from October 8 through 12. Jump into the Rust Belt for the first time, or get your friends together and bring them into your squad.

ARC Raiders is also discounted 50% on all platforms right now, so this is a good time to try it out and see if you're ready to become the Rust Belt's newest Raider.

# Collector Set DLC

Raiders looking for the complete Frozen Trail experience can pick up the Collector Set DLC to gear up for the icy peaks ahead. The set contains a new cosmetic set, the Renzo, a Dragon's Breath Weapon Stencil, a Bob Hair Style, and 2,400 Raider Tokens. It also unlocks access to the Frozen Trail Premium Reward Pass.

Take a look at the Collector Set DLC to see all the cosmetics and rewards included.

# Patch notes

For the complete breakdown of new content, features, fixes, and everything else, check out the Patch Notes.

See you on the trail, Raiders.

The ARC Raiders Team
